name: Manual: State Machine Transitions
modt_content:
system
    name StateTest

obj LightSwitch
    attr IsOn: bool [initial(false), state]

    method Toggle() [set(IsOn, !IsOn, Click)]
        pre !IsOn
        post IsOn

    method TurnOff() [set(IsOn, false, Click, true)]
        pre IsOn
        post IsOn
